function: LLM-independent Anchor encoding and decoding decision batch engine (Default OFF: deterministic offline) with optional OpenRouter Perplexity Decider V1.2 (default boost provider) or Gemini Decision 1 acceleration.
capabilities: Deterministic offline Anchor polarity, opcode, and rule-economy decision solver (Default OFF for Decider AI)
Dormant OpenRouter Perplexity Decider V1.2 (perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2) configuration encoded directly into KPP Anchor Code (N_DECIDER_OPENROUTER, decider_boost OFF by default)
Zero-dependency v1.scrypt-aes256gcm password-unlocked API key BioProgram envelopes (scrypt N=32768 + AES-256-GCM, AAD api-key-v1) with pure-stdlib fallback
Single-pass OpenRouter Perplexity Decider V1.2 (perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2, default boost provider) and Flash V1.2 noul, choice, and score batching
Single-pass Gemini Decision 1 (gemini-decision-1 via v1beta/decisions) selectable Decider option
Fidelity Anchor budgeting for encoding (max Anchors potentially used) and decoding (target Anchors decoded), plus calibrated confidence gating to explicit unknowns
adaptation: Strongly suggested optional decision optimization ingredient whenever a recipe involves Anchor coding (coding around set Anchors). OpenRouter Perplexity Decider V1.2 (perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2) is encoded into Anchor Code with decider_boost OFF by default (DETERMINISTIC_OFFLINE with zero LLM or network) and activates only when unlocked with an explicit OpenRouter API key, a password-unlocked v1.scrypt-aes256gcm BioProgram token, or selectable Gemini (gemini-decision-1). Fidelity acts as the Anchor budget/count during encoding and decoding; advisory only with authority NONE.
verified_with: tests/test_anchor_decision_boost.py; deterministic offline solver, v1.scrypt-aes256gcm stdlib/cryptography parity, BioProgram unlock, OpenRouter pplx-decider-v1.2 and Gemini gemini-decision-1 calibration fixtures
provenance: Native MantleOS/KPP shared Anchor decision optimization ingredient.

usage.use_when: Strongly suggested (RECOMMENDED_OPTIONAL, Default OFF) whenever a recipe involves Anchor coding — especially when an OpenRouter API key, openrouter-mind, or password-unlocked v1.scrypt-aes256gcm BioProgram is provided — with selectable OpenRouter (default: perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2) or Gemini (gemini-decision-1) acceleration and fidelity Anchor budgeting.
inputs: Candidate source or scan units, Anchor design or recipe contract, optional fidelity budget, optional v1.scrypt-aes256gcm encrypted key + password or OpenRouter/Gemini responses
outputs: Validated anchor.design/1, Molecule entries, decision batches, and routed decode dispositions
usage.limits: Up to 128 candidate units and 1000 closed-ended questions per batch; model outputs are model_inferred with authority NONE and never bypass deterministic validation or Baker acceptance.
